title: Early birds
statementMd:
For each booking show the number of days between booking and departure. List the 5 earliest-booked (largest gap), ties by booking id.

Expected columns: `id`, `days_ahead`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.id, CAST(julianday(f.depart_date) - julianday(b.booked_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_ahead FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id ORDER BY days_ahead DESC, b.id LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
